comment: Stock snippets that differ on Unwoke. Mirror injects a box under each needle. New stock ujust names are auto-paired to overlay recipes (set-foo-modules → set-foo) or get a why/setup box + mirror-cmds issue. Do not add Flathub/on as a silent default.

cmds.note: Same command as stock. On Unwoke it asks before unfiltered Flathub, Flatpak lockdown, temp noexec, mic, and Bluetooth. Stock’s script would skip those questions and leave games broken. Nothing silent.

cmds.code:
ujust set-flathub verified
# or: ujust set-flathub full
cmds.note: Flathub is off here. There is no Bazaar/GNOME Software/Discover. verified matches stock’s default remote. full is their unfiltered.

cmds.code:
ujust install-vpn
# or: ujust install-proton / install-ivpn / install-mullvad
cmds.note: Stock install-vpn is intercepted. WireGuard first. Tailscale is an asked extra RPM origin. Their script is not run (it skipped overlay questions and could disable Unbound).

cmds.code:
ujust install-docker
# prefer: podman (already installed)
# undo: ujust uninstall-docker
cmds.note: Intercepted. Docker CE is a root-equivalent daemon (group docker = root). Stock leftover: container userns. Overlay asks those first and prefers podman. Nothing silent. Uninstall is leftover stock.

needles: How do I manage potentially dangerous
cmds.note: Intercepted. Asks leftover container userns + ptrace first. Podman stays; toolbox wrappers are not required.
Our toolbox/distrobox binaries are stubs. The intercepted assemble asks set-toolbox on first, then stock’s leftover container-userns prompt.
That stock command rebases you off Unwoke onto their GHCR. Stay on ghcr.io/sergi270710267/… after the signed reboot. Pick the flavor on Install.
Stock only loads BT kernel modules. We also mask bluetooth.service and rfkill. The stock command alone is not enough here. Wi-Fi is not touched.

Webcam/mic capture is already locked (speakers stay). Stock’s command turns modules off; you want the opposite to use a camera. Then grant the browser: ujust set-brave-devices off if policy is blocking it.
Avahi and ModemManager are masked on Unwoke. That one toggle is the overlay path. cups/geoclue stay stock’s masks. Then still open firewall mDNS as they describe.

cmds.code:
ujust set-brew on
# new shell, then brew works like stock
cmds.note: Homebrew is off until you toggle it. Stock ships it on PATH.
toolbox / distrobox are wrappers until you opt in. podman stays. Then their Distrobox command works.
Stock audit still applies (their kernel, USBGuard, kargs). Also run the overlay check so trampoline / flavor / no leftover store are covered.

cmds.code:
ujust set-admin-split add NAME
# or skip the first-boot prompt: ujust set-admin-split off
cmds.note: Unwoke already asks for a daily (non-wheel) user before GDM/SDDM. Stock create-admin still exists if you skipped that. Wheel is blocked from the greeter.

cmds.code:
ujust set-trivalent-network-sandbox on   # default on *-trivalent
ujust set-trivalent-referrers on
cmds.note: On *-trivalent, JIT-less / no WebGL / extension block / NSS may already be forced by overlay policy. Origin uses ujust set-brave-*. Do not Bubblejail Trivalent.
